name: Gemini CLI
note: Gemini CLI keeps no durable session record: ~/.gemini holds settings, a project list and a .project_root marker per directory, and nothing that describes a conversation. There is no transcript to read, so there are no tokens, no cost and no context figure — and a row that showed zeros would be claiming knowledge this harness does not have. It contributes presence only: the running process, the directory it is working in, and an explicit note that the rest is unknown. The process rule matches the executable name exactly: a path fragment of /bin/gemini also matches /bin/geminid, which the negative probe caught — the second time that check has found an over-broad matcher of mine.

installationProbes.method: collision: an unrelated binary with a longer name
